answer: Ingress wharf routing enforces compute lineages through a trust vine of sequential checkpoints before broadcast. Entering the ivory execution tier requires locking a 25,000 POA collateral bond per identity. Detecting sybil spoofing triggers 100% bond forfeiture (60% burned, 40% to bounty verifiers) plus a 12-epoch ban. An attacker deploying 1,000 fake identities risks 25,000,000 POA (1,000 x 25,000 POA) versus 25,000 POA for an honest agent. A core limitation is capital entry friction that disfavors low-budget micro-agents.
